Title: Ajay's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Ajay - 33 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Hema - 65 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Anita - 25 years, daughter
Look: green saree

Places

1. The mall - a row of shops, an escalator

Scene 1: The mall - Day

[Ajay stands in the mall. Hema stands near him.]

Ajay: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Ajay tries on a new jacket.]

Ajay (gently): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Ajay pays at the counter.]

Hema: "Exactly right."

[Ajay carries the shopping bags out.]

Ajay: "What a day to remember!"
